Name: Single Tile Vertical Wall
Author: cflare
Description:
I was disappointed that creating a vertical wall meant taking up two tiles in width, taking up more real estate than was necessary. 
To allow for single width vertical walls I created this mashup tileset that gives you just about every combination of single width vertical wall connections that I could come up with using the vanilla assets.

It also allows for a directly diagonal southern wall.

As of now, it's an untested tileset, so use at your own risk.
